title: typha angustifolia subsp. angustata
intro: Typha angustifolia subsp. angustata, commonly known as narrow-leaved cattail, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Typhaceae). The narrow-leaved cattail has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce swelling, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it useful in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Typha angustifolia subsp. angustata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
